questions.stem: What role do carrier proteins play in active transport?

options.text: They produce ATP to power the transport process
They form channels that allow free diffusion of all molecules
They break down substances before they cross the membrane
They bind to specific molecules and use energy to move them across the membrane against the concentration gradient

questions.explanation: Carrier proteins in the cell membrane bind to specific molecules and use energy from ATP to change shape, transporting the molecules across the membrane from low to high concentration. Each carrier protein is specific to a particular substance.
